notes.text: Manage tests per worktree through adapters, a queue, and a configurable maximum number of parallel tests. Validate compatibility with the Angular and Django fixture projects under ~/development.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Implemented the first vertical slice on feat/test-runner-adapters: Node.js and Django discovery adapters, a persisted FIFO queue, a global limit from 1 to 16, one active run per worktree, process-tree cancellation and timeout handling, bounded history and logs, dashboard controls, authenticated HTTP endpoints, and idempotent MCP tools. Real scheduler runs passed against angular-switcher-fixture with pnpm run build and django-switcher-fixture with .venv/bin/python manage.py test. Keep the item open until the rebuilt controller is installed and the browser flow is exercised through the managed service.

problem: Humans and agents can start overlapping test or build processes from different terminals without a shared resource limit, clear worktree attribution, cancellation, or durable results.

risk.rollback: Remove the test queue endpoints and dashboard tab while preserving historical rows. Development-server management remains independent.

scope: Discover finite Node.js verification scripts and Django manage.py test through typed adapters resolved against each exact Git-discovered worktree.
Queue test runs FIFO with a persisted global parallel limit and at most one active process tree per worktree.
Record project, worktree, commit, branch, dirty state, actor, command, timestamps, result, and bounded output without accepting arbitrary browser or MCP commands.
Expose queue settings, preset selection, live status, history, output, and cancellation through the dashboard and authenticated HTTP API.
Expose read, enqueue, status, and owner-only cancellation through MCP with idempotent enqueue requests.
Terminate owned test process trees on timeout, cancellation, and controller shutdown; recover unfinished persisted records as interrupted.
title: Manage framework-aware tests per worktree
validation: With limit two, verify two different worktrees run concurrently while a second run for either occupied worktree remains queued.
Verify lowering the global limit does not terminate active runs and new jobs wait until capacity is available.
Verify stale presets, arbitrary worktree paths, duplicate MCP retries, foreign-session cancellation, timeouts, and controller recovery are handled safely.
Run a discovered Angular verification preset and Django manage.py test through the scheduler against the fixture repositories under ~/development.
Exercise the complete dashboard and MCP flows against the rebuilt managed controller.
value: Developers and agents share one bounded source of truth for local verification work instead of competing test processes in separate terminals.
